## Health Score Rubric

Score six areas from 0 to 100 after the QA pass.

### Stability — 25
Uncaught exceptions, crash screens, and pages returning 5xx.
- Start at 100. −30 per page that crashes or returns 5xx; −10 per unique uncaught exception (by message). Floor 0.

### Flows — 25
Sign-up, log-in, search, checkout, settings, and any flow in the test plan.
- Start at 100. −35 per flow that cannot be completed; −15 per flow that completes only with a workaround. Floor 0.

### Navigation — 15
Same-origin links and client-side routes.
- Start at 100. −15 per unique broken destination (repeatable 4xx/5xx or missing route). Floor 0.

### Presentation — 15
Layout breaks, clipped or overlapping text, broken images, mobile overflow.
- Start at 100. −10 per distinct issue, whether it appears at one viewport or several. Floor 0.

### Accessibility — 10
Unlabeled controls, keyboard traps, missing alt text, low contrast.
- Start at 100. −20 per keyboard trap; −8 per other distinct issue. Floor 0.

### Copy — 10
Typos, placeholder text, wrong labels.
- Start at 100. −4 per distinct issue. Floor 0.

### Notes
- The numbers after each heading are that area's weights; they add up to 100.
- Count each defect once, in the area listed first above that fits it, even if it appears on several pages.
- Combine the six area scores using the weights to get the overall health score, and report it as a whole number with the six area scores beside it.
- If an area was not checked at all, say so and leave it out of the overall score.
